text:
marie: quick heads-up — onboarding the raven-lite int8 canary showed a weird cluster of parse failures but only in sampled logs. want to sync on a short telemetry-sampler sprint to get actionable signals :mag:
priya: noted. what exactly did you see? counts, sample rate?
marie: ~0.8% parse_fail among the canary traffic but the sampler only kept ~1/200 requests. when I dumped the raw generations a lot had truncated array suffixes like \"...]\n\" or spilled metadata. suspect kv-prefix & batch boundary interactions.
tom: low sample rate makes it noisy. increasing sampling for errors + boundary cases sounds right but costy. can we do targeted sampling instead of blanket increase? :money_with_wings:
kevin: agree. propose two-tier sampler: 1) error-triggered 100% capture for the session; 2) heuristic low-rate capture for clean responses. then compute parse_failure_rate, avg_tokens_truncated, and funcall_mismatch_rate per model-variant.
alexa: can we tag the samples with causal context? model, quant, batch-size, kv-prefix-length. otherwise hard to attribute. also include decoder tail tokens.
marie: yes. candidate tags: model=raven-lite-v2, quant=int8, batch=4, kv_prefix_len=128, route=hosted-east.
priya: I can implement sampler glue. thinking: error detector + sliding-window error streak indicator to lift to 100% capture. will add a `sample_reason` dimension.
marie: perfect. add `sample_reason=heuristic_repair` for outputs we attempted auto-repair on. we need a CSV/ndjson sink for quick offline tooling.
deploy-bot: CI run for sampler branch started — https://ci/redwood/3898/sampler-probe — will post artifacts when done.
kevin: for experiments, let's run A/B: baseline sampler vs targeted sampler across 50k requests. metric targets: reduce missed_regressions (false negatives) by >60% while keeping sample volume growth <3x. also track e2e cost delta.
tom: timeline? can we do this in 72h?
priya: I'll spin the sampler in staging tonight. patch below for sampling policy (psuedo):
```
# sampler config
matchers:
  - type: parse_error
    capture: 100%
  - type: heuristic_suffix_mismatch
    capture: 2%
  - type: default
    capture: 0.5%
emit_tags: [model,quant,batch,kv_prefix_len,route,sample_reason]
sink: ndjson://s3/redwood-samples/eng-ml/raven-lite/v2/
```
marie: nice. can you also include a small inline transformer that computes `truncation_hint` = true if last_token in {"," , "]", "..."} ? that will help triage.
alexa: added suggestion: attach a tiny context diff for kv-prefix windows when capture triggered — helps see if prefix shift caused boundary.
kevin: for analysis i'll wire up a Jupyter that computes parse_failure_rate per tag and dump a heatmap. also will include a replay harness to re-run 1k failing sessions against int16 vs int8.
marie: action items: priya implement sampler + sink (owner), kevin run analysis + replay (owner), alexa add kv-prefix diff, tom monitor cost & routing. rendezvous sync in #eng-ml tomorrow 10am.
priya: on it. will push PR and ping here when CI artifacts land.
tom: :thumbsup: thanks team.
marie: thanks — goal is to turn these noisy parse alarms into a stable signal we can use for automatic rollbacks.
